annualDemandKits.title: Elgin Courier: SpaceX closer to $855M Starlink expansion
annualDemandKits.excerpt: Stated target of 10 million kits per year by the end of 2026. Treated as demo demand under ASSUMPTION A4, not as a verified actual.

annualDemandKitsUse.note: The public 10,000,000 figure is treated as plant-wide annual finished-kit demand. One kit is one finished unit at pack-out (A5).

calendarDays.note: Demand is spread evenly over 365 days. Seasonality is unknown.

hoursPerDay.note: Coverage is modeled as 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, no holidays.

parallelLines.note: 4 independent identical kit lines. The real line count is unknown.

meanDowntimeEventSeconds.note: Mean downtime event of 900 seconds, with an exact downtime budget per machine.

tickSeconds.note: Tick is 1.0 second. Only scheduled production seconds are simulated.

downtimeReasons.note: Reasons cycle breakdown, changeover, material_wait, quality_hold at 4, 3, 2, 1 per 10 events. Not plant data.

bufferCapacity.note: Inter-station buffers are ignored (queue capacity 0). A what-if lever can raise this.

endOfShiftWip.note: Incomplete units at the end of the shift are WIP.

starts.note: New units start at S1 whenever it is idle and up, with no takt-release limit.

name.note: Generic teaching layout of six stations in series. Not a confirmed factory map.

cycleTimeSeconds.note: Engineered cycle time 12.0 seconds. Not a measured cycle.

parallelUnits.note: 1 parallel unit per station. Real staffing is unknown.

operators.note: 1 operator per station. Real staffing is unknown.

firstPassYield.note: First-pass yield 0.97. Real yields are unknown. Scrap does not rework.

performance.note: Performance efficiency 0.95 versus engineered cycle. Real performance is unknown.
